summary: Flathead County, MT lookout on the Flathead NF: 50-foot metal tower and cabin in 1934, abandoned 1948, now gone; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Firelookout.com gives 1948 for the Sanders lookout; Forest Lookouts gives 1948 for the Grubb Mountain patrol lookout

evidence.supports: 1934 50-foot metal tower and cabin; patrol 2.5 miles south on Grubb Mountain; abandoned 1948; gone
evidence.quote: 1934: 50' metal tower, cabin. Patrol 2.5 miles south on Grubb Mtn. Abandoned 1948. Gone.

evidence.supports: listed as tower, gone, at 48.29037 north 114.83682 west
Grubb Mountain patrol lookout 2.5 miles south of the Sanders Mountain lookout
evidence.quote: A patrol lookout 2 1/2 miles south of Sanders Mountain L.O. (Kresek)

evidence.supports: July 1930 newspaper item on a pack string going in to set up camp for a lookout on Grubb Mountain
evidence.quote: A pack string has gone in to Grubb Mountain in Pleasant valley today to establish camp for a lookout

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives 1948 as the year the Sanders lookout was abandoned. Forest Lookouts gives 1948 as the year the Grubb Mountain patrol lookout was abandoned. The story reports both and does not say they are one closure.

notes_for_editor: Two pages carry the core facts (1934 tower and cabin, 1948 abandonment, gone). Firelookout.com credits a photo to the Dave Masters collection, but no image URL was found, so no photo is added. The 1948 date is ambiguous between the Sanders lookout and its Grubb Mountain patrol; the story says so. Staffing, fires, access and present-day remains are not in any source found. The 1930 pack-string item concerns Grubb Mountain and is used only as context for the patrol.
